newsitem.title: CHINA: China says 23.8 percent of HK flags sub-standard.
newsitem.headline: China says 23.8 percent of HK flags sub-standard.

text.p: At least 23.8 percent of flags to represent the Hongkong Special Administractive Region after it reverts to Chinese sovereignty on July 1 are sub-standard, the State Bureau of Technology Supervision said.

Supervision officials selected six enterprises from Beijing, Shanghai and four other major cities for a spot check on the quality of Hong Kong flags, the bureau said in a report carried in the People's Daily.
They also chose two Hong Kong emblem manufacturers from the northeastern area for a similar random check and said the results were satisfactory, with all emblems up to standard, it said.
Enterprises that turned out sub-standard flags or emblems would be disqualified if the quality of their products remained poor, the newspaper said without giving further details.
China has hailed its resumption of sovereignty over Hong Kong after 156 years of British colonial rule as one of the top events of the year and is determined that nothing should mar the handover.
